title: Structured Logging with Request Context Propagation
userStory: As an AI Multi-Agent System developer, I want structured logging with automatic request context propagation so that I can trace requests across agent invocations and debug distributed system issues efficiently.
description: Implement a structured logging system that provides JSON-formatted output with automatic binding of request context (request_id, session_id, agent_name). The logger must be thread-safe, support all standard log levels, and provide both a context manager and decorator for temporary context binding.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Logger outputs valid JSON with 'message', 'context', and 'timestamp' fields
Context variables (request_id, session_id, agent_name) are automatically bound to all log entries
Context binding is thread-safe using ContextVars - no cross-thread contamination
All log levels (DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL) are supported
Context manager allows temporary context binding that auto-restores on exit
Decorator enables automatic context binding for function execution
Nested context managers properly restore previous context values
Extra keyword arguments are included in the JSON context

exampleUsage.globalContext:
set_context(request_id='req-123', session_id='sess-456', agent_name='agent-1')
logger.info('Message with global context')
